x: We had secured the written leave of Earl Spencer, who then owned Wimbledon Common, to run over it, and still claim to be the only club who can drop paper over the heath, as having the right before there were such things as conservators and their bye-laws; and all existing rights were saved by the Act."

Much of this land was previously in the ownership of Earl Spencer, by whose permission Thames Hare and Hounds held the first cross country races ever, celebrating their centenary last year, it will be recalled.
